verdict: Ads have not launched; overdue milestones are being resolved now.
narrative: No paid ads ran this period — zero spend across Google and Meta — because five launch milestones that were due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete. Your Google Business Profile carried all engagement activity for the 28 days, generating 76 total actions, but GBP activity dropped sharply in the last seven days and has recorded zero actions for four consecutive days through August 29. On the pipeline side, 16 opportunities entered your CRM this period but none have converted to appointments or won matters, which means the intake step needs attention in parallel with the ad launch. Resolving the outstanding pre-launch items is the immediate priority so paid channels can go live and begin generating inbound leads.
